question: Simplify : [0.08 - {3.5 - 4.9 - (12.5 - 7.8 - 4.6)}]
solution:
Concept used:

BODMAS rule 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9344caa8dc7c796313d935818212cabe545a4a2e63bf8952cf8ab33ad785b11d.png] 

calculation:

[0.08 - {3.5 - 4.9 - (12.5 - 7.8 - 4.6)}]

⇒ [0.08 - {3.5 - 4.9 - (0.1)}]

⇒ [0.08 - {3.5 - 5}]

⇒ 0.08 + 1.5

⇒ 1.58

∴ The answer is 1.58.
